    • Maolei Huang BOTAK
    Researcher
    Alibaba

    I am a researcher and senior algorithm engineer at Alibaba in Beijing, specializing in large-scale ranking and recommendation systems, supply optimization and revenue optimization, and LLM-powered ranking and agents. My work spans the full lifecycle of industrial AI, from problem formulation, data and feature development, and model design to online serving, experimentation, and continuous optimization under strict latency and reliability constraints. My research interests include generative ranking, user behavior and intent modeling, temporal learning and delayed-feedback learning, LLM alignment, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, multi-agent collaboration, multi-task learning, cross-domain transfer, and multi-objective optimization.

    I received my M.S. in Computer Architecture from the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS), where I studied at the Institute of Computing Technology (ICT), Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), and my B.S. in Software Engineering from Shandong University (SDU). My work has led to publications at KDD, AAAI, SIGIR, ICLR, and IEEE IoT-J, including first-author publications at KDD, AAAI, and SIGIR, as well as granted invention patents. I also serve as a reviewer for leading AI, information retrieval, and data mining venues, including KDD, RecSys, and SIGIR. My goal is to build a productive feedback loop between research and production: real-world challenges inspire new algorithmic formulations, while research advances are translated into robust, scalable systems that deliver measurable improvements in user experience and business efficiency.
